div.style: color: rgb(58, 27, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Esqueleto:
∫ arcsin(x) dx = x·arcsin(x) + √(1 − x²) + C

div.style: color: rgb(13, 47, 82) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
u = arcsin(x), dv = dx
du = dx/√(1 − x²), v = x

div.style: color: rgb(13, 47, 82) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(74, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
∫ x·(1 − x²)^(−1/2) dx
tiene antiderivada simple:
−√(1 − x²)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 58, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
x·arcsin(x) − (−√(1 − x²)) + C
= x·arcsin(x) + √(1 − x²) + C

div.style: color: rgb(74, 16, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Verificación por derivada:
d/dx [x·arcsin(x) + √(1 − x²)] = arcsin(x)
